沉.def: to sink, to submerge; profound, deep

ety.hint: An excessive 冗 amount of water 氵

origin.says: A variant of 沈: 氵 (water) plus 冘 as the sound, with 冘 reshaped into 冗 (superfluous): to sink.

沉.name: sink

陷.def: to sink, to plunge; trap, pitfall

ety.hint: A place 阝 with a pit 臽; 臽 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 臽 (a person in a pit) as the sound and meaning; 臽 was the first form of this word, 阝 was added later: to fall into a pit, a trap.

陷.name: sink in

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 合 (join) as the sound: the sound of laughter, ha.
勿 (do not) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: the mind not paying attention, to neglect; also 'suddenly'.

幅.def: piece, roll, strip; breadth, width; measure word for textiles

ety.hint: A roll 畐 of cloth 巾; 畐 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 畐 (full jar) as the sound: the width of a piece of cloth; a measure word for pictures and textiles.

幅.name: cloth width

origin.says: 黍 (millet) for the meaning, cut short, plus a variant of 利 (profit) as the sound: the top is the 利 variant, the bottom (人 person + 氺 water) is what is left of 黍. 'Black' and 'numerous' are later uses.
A picture of a tree: branches above, trunk and roots below; hence wood.

木.name: wood
木.in: 样新机想相保权根集标格查亲构条校案模采杀极村深林析媒困杂材梦某检核概板嘛楼李枪楚染禁探休松树彩荣操架植桥菜档麻床械谋森棒

ety.hint: Another 又 kind of bird 鸟

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms drew a rooster with comb and tail. Later written 雞 or 鷄: a bird part (隹 or 鳥) plus 奚 as the sound. The simplified form replaces 奚 with 又 and writes 鳥 as 鸟.

ety.hint: Word 言 of one's success 兴

origin.says: From 譽: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 與 (give, lift) as the sound: words that raise someone, praise and fame. The simplified form writes 與 like the top of 兴 (rise).
Simplified from 謀: 言 (speech), shortened to 讠, for the meaning plus 某 (a certain) as the sound: talking a plan through.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 吳 (shouting man) as the sound: pleasure, amusement. Simplified from 娛 with 吴.
米 (rice, grain) for the meaning plus a sound part: grain as food, provisions. Simplified from 糧, whose sound part 量 (measure) was replaced by the simpler 良 (good).

ety.hint: The sun 日 rising over the horizon 一

origin.says: The sun 日 (sun) above a line. Read traditionally as the sun rising over the horizon, dawn; another reading sees 日 (sun) plus 丁 (nail) as the sound, reduced to a stroke as in 正 (upright).

旦.name: daybreak
旦.in: 得但量查担宣碍坦胆擅恒颤渣喧昼喳渲檀

origin.says: 工 (work, a tool) for the meaning plus 丂 as the sound: skilled at work, clever, ingenious; also 'by coincidence'.

烧.def: to burn, to bake; to heat, to roast

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: to burn, to cook over fire, to heat. Simplified from 燒.

烧.name: burn

览.def: to look over, to inspect, to view, to perceive

origin.says: Simplified from 覽: 監 (inspect) as the sound plus 見 (see) for the meaning: to look over. The top of 監 was cut to a simpler shape and 見 became 见.

览.name: look over

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 成 (accomplish) as the sound: words that hold true, sincere. Simplified from 誠, with 言 (speech) in short form.
Simplified from 賬: 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 长 (long) as the sound: money records, accounts, debts.

ety.hint: A ghost with a scary face

origin.says: A picture of a kneeling figure with a huge, unnatural head (perhaps a mask); the small 厶-like mark at the lower right is a tail added later. A ghost or demon.

鬼.name: ghost
鬼.in: 魂魔魅瑰愧魄魁槐魏巍

origin.says: Simplified from 暫: 斩 (to chop) as the sound plus 日 (sun, day) for the meaning: a short span of time, temporary.

厉.def: whetstone; to grind, to sharpen, to whet

origin.says: Simplified from 厲: 厂 (cliff, stone) for the meaning plus a scorpion-like sound part: a whetstone, hence sharp, strict, severe. The simple form put 万 (ten thousand) inside.

厉.name: whetstone

倾.def: to upset, to pour out, to overflow

origin.says: Simplified from 傾: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 頃 (tilted head) as the sound: to lean, tip over, pour out. Only 頁 (head) became 页.

倾.name: lean over

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: the loose end of a thread, hence clue, beginning, state of mind. Simplified from 緒 (糸 written 纟).
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 俞 (yes; a dugout boat) as the sound: a person who steals.

拜.def: to bow, to salute; to worship, to pay respects

ety.hint: Two hands 手 put together in respect

origin.says: Early forms show a hand with a rooted plant, or a hand and a head bowed to it; later written as two hands put together in respect: to bow, to worship.

拜.name: bow down

掌.def: in charge; the palm of the hand, the sole of the foot

origin.says: 尚 (esteem) as the sound plus 手 (hand) for the meaning: the palm of the hand; holding in the hand gives 'to be in charge'.

掌.name: palm

挺.def: to straighten, to stand upright; rigid, stiff

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 廷 (court) as the sound: to straighten up, to stick out; upright, and from that 'quite'.

挺.name: stand straight

尝.def: to taste; to experience, to experiment with

origin.says: From 嘗: 尚 (esteem) as the sound plus 旨 (tasty) for the meaning: to taste, to try. In the simplified form 旨 became 云 (cloud) and 尚 lost its 口 (mouth).

尝.name: sample

origin.says: 犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: the pig. An old variant of 豬, where 豕 (pig) was the meaning part; 犭 replaced it.

ety.hint: A man 元 puts on a cap 冖 with his hand 寸

origin.says: 冖 (cover, hat) and 寸 (hand) with 元 (head) as the sound and meaning: a hand putting a cap on the head. Cap, crown; also "first place".

ety.hint: A man 刂 in jail 开

origin.says: 井 (well) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: punishment. 井 later warped into the shape 开 (open), which hides the sound part.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 禺 (a monkey-like creature) as the sound: a figure of a person, an idol, a puppet; then a pair or mate, and by chance.

阿.def: an initial particle, a prefix used for names; used in transliterations

origin.says: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 可 (can) as the sound: first a big hill or bend. Now used for its sound as a prefix before names and kin words, and in foreign names.

阿.name: ah prefix

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 羊 (sheep) as the sound: a vast body of water, the ocean; then 'from overseas', foreign.
良 (good) as the sound, its last stroke dropped, plus 月 (moon): the clear light of the moon, hence bright and clear.

ety.hint: A tiger 虍 stalking in the bushes 业

origin.says: 虍 (tiger head) as the sound plus 丘 (hill) for the meaning: a great mound, then empty, hollow. The hill part became the 业 shape.

租.def: to rent, to lease; tax, rent

ety.hint: Regularly paid 且 tribute in grain 禾

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 且 (altar) as the sound: land tax paid in grain, later rent and hire.

租.name: rent

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 乃 (and then) as the sound: breast, milk, and grandmother; earlier written 嬭.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 自 (self) as sound and hint: 'we, us' including the listener, a late colloquial word. It replaced the older form 偺.
金 (metal) for the meaning plus 𧴪 (small shells) as the sound: a lock, chains. Simplified from 鎖, with 金 written 钅 and 貝 written 贝.

ety.hint: A mountain 山 cliff 厂; 干 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 屵 (cliff, made of 山 mountain over 厂 cliff) for the meaning plus 干 (shield) as the sound: the high edge of land by water, a shore.

圳.def: a furrow in a field; a small drainage ditch

ety.hint: A furrow cut in the earth 土 by a stream 川; 川 also provides the pronunciation

宁.def: calm, peaceful; healthy; rather; to prefer

origin.says: Simplified from 寧: a house 宀 (roof) with a vessel 皿 (dish) and a heart 心 (heart), contentment, with 丁 (nail) at the bottom for the sound. The short form keeps only 宀 (roof) and 丁 (nail).

宁.name: calm

origin.says: 雨 (rain) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: first rain falling in drops, then scattered bits, a remainder, and zero.

腐.def: to spoil, to rot, to decay; rotten

origin.says: 府 (mansion) as the sound plus 肉 (flesh) for the meaning: flesh that has gone bad, 'rotten'.

腐.name: rot

origin.says: Often read as a drawing of a bent arm or elbow (the original of 肘, elbow), borrowed for the number nine; others see a hook or a grasping hand.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 舍 (house) as the sound: a late, colloquial character for the spoken word 'what?'.
氵 (water) plus 少 (few, small dots): tiny grains by the water, sand. One source reads 少 as the sound instead.

盛.def: abundant, flourishing; to contain; to fill

origin.says: 成 (accomplish) as the sound plus 皿 (dish) for the meaning: to fill a vessel, then full, abundant, flourishing.

盛.name: brimming

origin.says: 串 (string) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: worry piercing the heart, trouble, illness. An older reading splits the top differently.
Replaces 遲: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 犀 (rhinoceros) as the sound, moving slowly, late. In 1956 犀 was replaced by 尺 (ruler) as a new sound part.
艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 重 (heavy) as the sound: first a plant name; borrowed for 'to direct, supervise' and the surname Dong.

诺.def: to promise; to approve, to assent to

origin.says: Simplified from 諾: 言 (speech), shortened to 讠, for the meaning plus 若 (as if, so) as the sound: answering 'yes, so it is', to assent and promise.

诺.name: promise

origin.says: Variant of 腳: 月 (here flesh, body) for the meaning plus 却 (to step back) as the sound: the part of the body you step with, foot or leg.
马 (horse) for the meaning plus 奇 (strange) as the sound: to ride astride a horse. Simplified from 騎, with the horse part 馬 written in its short cursive shape 马.

践.def: to trample, to tread on, to walk over

origin.says: Simplified from 踐: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 戔 (small; sound) as the sound, to tread on. The sound part is written in its cursive simplified shape 戋. One reading also takes 戋 as 'small steps'.

践.name: trample

origin.says: Simplified from 藍: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 監 (supervise) as the sound: the indigo plant, hence blue. It uses the simplified 监.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 烏, a bird

origin.says: From 鳥, a picture of a bird with a hanging tail. The simplified form comes from its cursive writing.

鸟.name: bird
鸟.in: 鸡鸦鹅鸭鸣鸽鹉鹦鹰鹃鸥莺鸯鸵鸳鸿鹊鹏鹤

origin.says: 彳 (step) for the meaning plus 巠 (warp threads) as the sound: a straight footpath, then a diameter, direct. Simplified from 徑; the right side is a shorthand of 巠 (warp threads).
From 淨: water for the meaning plus 爭 (strive) as the sound. The modern form uses 冫 (ice) in place of 氵 (water), as the variant 凈 did, and the short 争: clean.
宀 (house) for the meaning plus 萈 (mountain goat) as the sound: a spacious house, wide. Simplified from 寬, the sound part written as 苋 (amaranth) without its dot.

惜.def: pity, regret; to rue; to begrudge

ety.hint: To feel 忄 for the past 昔; 昔 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 昔 (former times) as the sound, which also hints at the past: feelings for what is gone, to regret, to cherish.

惜.name: regret

origin.says: Simplified from 窮: 穴 (cave, confinement) for the meaning plus 躬 (body) as the sound: hemmed in, at the end, hence poor. The simplified form writes 力 (strength) under 穴 instead.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap, womb) as the sound and hint: the womb and its membrane; so siblings of one womb.
心 (heart) for the meaning plus 奴 (slave) as the sound: anger, rage.
日 (sun) for the meaning plus 辰 (clam hoe, also a time of day) as the sound: early morning, when the sun comes up and work starts.

绕.def: to entwine, to wind around; to orbit, to revolve

origin.says: 纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: thread winding around something, to wind, to go around. Simplified from 繞.

绕.name: wind around

赏.def: reward; to appreciate; to bestow, to grant

origin.says: 贝 (cowry shell, money) for the meaning plus 尚 (esteem) as the sound: to give a reward, then to enjoy, appreciate. One source reads the sound part as 商 (trade). Simplified from 賞 (貝 → 贝).

赏.name: reward

乘.def: ride, mount; to make use of; to ascend; to multiply

ety.hint: Two feet 北 climbing a beanstalk 禾

origin.says: Old forms draw a person (大) standing on top of a tree (木), feet visible: to climb up, to mount, to ride. The modern shape turned into 禾 (grain) and 北 (north).

乘.name: mount

origin.says: Simplified from 詳: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 羊 (sheep) as the sound: to explain in full, detailed. Only the speech part was simplified.

搭.def: to attach, to build, to join

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 荅 (small bean) as the sound: to put up, to join, to lay over.

搭.name: put up

origin.says: Simplified from 儀: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 義 (justice) as the sound, now its simplified form 义: a person's proper bearing, ceremony; later also instruments.

趋.def: to hurry, to hasten; to approach, to be attracted to

origin.says: 走 (to walk) for the meaning plus 芻 (fodder) as the sound: to hurry towards. Simplified from 趨 by writing 芻 (fodder) as 刍.

趋.name: hurry toward

逻.def: to patrol, to inspect; patrol, watch; logic

origin.says: Simplified from 邏: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 羅 (bird net) as the sound: walking the rounds, to patrol; now also in 逻辑 (logic). It uses the simplified 罗.

逻.name: patrol

袭.def: to attack, to raid; to inherit

origin.says: Simplified from 襲: 衣 (clothes) for the meaning with 龍 (dragon) as the sound, itself cut down from a doubled dragon; 龍 became 龙. First an extra robe put on, later to raid, to inherit.

袭.name: raid

origin.says: Simplified from 齡 (齒 became 齿): 齿 (teeth) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: age, since teeth show how old one is.
From 貓: 豸 (crouching beast) plus 苗 (sprout) as the sound, miáo like the cat's call. The simplified form swaps 豸 for the animal sign 犭.

赌.def: to bet, to gamble, to wager

origin.says: 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: to wager money, to gamble. Simplified from 賭 (貝 written 贝).

赌.name: gamble
